Nineteen comments

Roland’s Return

This is a major key and a bit brighter tune than the other “Roland’s Return” in the database, and this is the first tune of a two tune set from Conor McCarthy’s and Annemarie McCormack’s recording “Ace and Deuce.” It is followed by McCarthy’s tune “The Ballycarroll Jig.” In the recording notes the couple dedicate the tune set to their friends and neighbors in Ballycarroll and “The Parish.”

↳ Posted by ∅ on April 6th, 2007.

Roche I, page 41, tune #92 ~ “Roland’s Return!” ~ Corrections

B-parts, next to the last bar, a mistake of one note raised an octave in the ABCs ~

K: Dmin ~ | G2 A BAG | AFD D2 |]

K: Emin ~ | A2 B cBA | BGE E2 |]

Admitting I’m in a mood that is decidedly minor, the tune and transcriptions here still ring as minor to my ears. The transcript I’ve given resolves for me on d, and if I push it to F it feels incomplete, unresolved. It does tend to float between modes, this I realize. The Roche settings finish final bars of both parts on D, and for me the F (or G in the transposition) doesn’t give the melody a satisfactory resolution… I did consider this when I kept finding others had been listing this tune as F Major.

It has been a pretty crazy week as I experiment with tendonitis and trying to get past my avoidance of considering the other option, the opinion of a doctor… Yes, I’m stubborn. Probably more that than shy. Are you surprised? Hey, at least twice in my life a doctor came close to killing me, once with an overdose, so maybe I have reasons for being reticent… So, maybe it is ‘shy’ rather than ‘stubborn’? It may have a lot to do with why I don’t like chemical solutions… Drugs should be a last resort, don’t you think? ;-)

↳ Posted by ceolachan on August 3rd, 2008.

Roland’s U-Turn, X:6

One of the many variations on Rambling Pitchfork. I had originally posted this in the comments of the Dmaj Rambling Pitchfork. (https://thesession.org/tunes/89). The version here was mentioned a couple other places and it was suggested that it get it’s own entry as, though it is definitely related to Rambling Pitchfork, it really IS quite different - more of a distant cousin than a slightly different setting.

This one is in Fmaj and has a lovely 3rd part.

I transcribed this from the CD “Late… In The Night” with Christy Barry, Conor McCarthy and Cyril O‘Donoghue - Recorded Live in O’Connors Bar Doolin (https://thesession.org/recordings/524). The track on the CD containing this tune is a set of Jigs called Vaughans Barn in Kilfenora - though it doesn’t say anything about the origins of this tune in particular.

↳ Posted by Grack on October 12th, 2008.

Rolands U-turn

The actual name of this is Rolands Return, from roches Irish Music Book, I got this tune from my father Johnny McCarthy (box) he told me he got it from Roches. There are two versions of this tune, I recorded my favourite version on Ace & Deuce. Christy plays the other version, first half mostly the same but 2nd half different. In this recording here (rolands u-turn) we played the 2 second halves making it a 3 part to settle a dispute!
C McCarthy
